step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard depicts a multi-region ML training architecture split between Region 1 and Region 2. Region 1 features an EC2 Placement Group coupled with FSx for Lustre storage, alongside an S3 bucket and standalone icons for Service Catalog and CloudFormation. S3 cross-region replication links the S3 bucket in Region 1 to an S3 bucket in Region 2. CloudFormation connects via a directed line to an EC2 cluster outline in Region 2 to spin up fallback compute capacity.
